import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem rotation_subgroup_reflections {n : ℕ} {hn : n ≠ 0}
    {R : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n)}
    (hR : R = Subgroup.closure {DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)}) :
    R ≠ ⊤ ∧
      (∀ i : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr i ∉ R) ∧
      (∀ K : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n), R ≤ K →
        (∃ i : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr i ∈ K) → K = ⊤) := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨hn⟩
  
  have hR_zpowers :
      Subgroup.zpowers (DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)) = R := by
    exact
      (Subgroup.zpowers_eq_closure (DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n))).trans hR.symm
  
  have hr_mem : ∀ j : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.r j ∈ R := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_surjective (n := n)) j
    have hmem :
        (DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)) ^ m ∈
          Subgroup.zpowers (DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)) :=
      Subgroup.zpow_mem_zpowers _ m
    have hmemR : (DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)) ^ m ∈ R := by
      simpa [hR_zpowers] using hmem
    simpa [DihedralGroup.r_one_zpow (n := n) (k := m), hm] using hmemR
  
  have hreflection_not_mem : ∀ i : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr i ∉ R := by
    intro i hi
    have hzpow :
        DihedralGroup.sr i ∈
          Subgroup.zpowers (DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)) := by
      simpa [hR_zpowers] using hi
    rcases Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hzpow with ⟨m, hm⟩
    have hrot :
        DihedralGroup.r (m : ZMod n) = DihedralGroup.sr i := by
      simpa [DihedralGroup.r_one_zpow (n := n) (k := m)] using hm
    simpa using hrot
  
  have hmul : ∀ j i : ZMod n,
      DihedralGroup.sr j * DihedralGroup.sr i ∈ R := by
    intro j i
    rw [DihedralGroup.sr_mul_sr]
    exact hr_mem (i - j)
  
  refine ⟨?_, hreflection_not_mem, ?_⟩
  · intro htop
    have hmem : DihedralGroup.sr 0 ∈ R := by
      simp [htop]
    exact hreflection_not_mem 0 hmem
  
  · intro K hRK hcontains
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcontains
    have hall : ∀ j : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr j ∈ K := by
      intro j
      have hp : DihedralGroup.sr j * DihedralGroup.sr i ∈ K :=
        hRK (hmul j i)
      have hinv : (DihedralGroup.sr i)⁻¹ ∈ K := K.inv_mem hi
      have hprod :
          (DihedralGroup.sr j * DihedralGroup.sr i) *
              (DihedralGroup.sr i)⁻¹ ∈ K :=
        K.mul_mem hp hinv
      simpa using hprod
  
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    cases' x with j j
    · exact hRK (hr_mem j)
    · exact hall j

log.message: All goals closed.

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem rotation_subgroup_reflections {n : ℕ} {hn : n ≠ 0}
    {R : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n)}
    (hR : R = Subgroup.closure {DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)}) :
    R ≠ ⊤ ∧
      (∀ i : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr i ∉ R) ∧
      (∀ K : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n), R ≤ K →
        (∃ i : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr i ∈ K) → K = ⊤) := by
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨hn⟩
  let H : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n) :=
    { carrier := Set.range DihedralGroup.r
      one_mem' := ⟨0, by simp⟩
      mul_mem' := by
        rintro _ _ ⟨i, rfl⟩ ⟨j, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨i + j, by simp⟩
      inv_mem' := by
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨-i, by simp⟩ }
  have hRH : R = H := by
    rw [hR]
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine (Subgroup.closure_le H).2 ?_
      rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
    · intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩
      have hi : DihedralGroup.r (i : ZMod n) =
          (DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)) ^ i.val := by
        rw [DihedralGroup.r_one_pow]
        rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
      rw [hi]
      exact pow_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)) _
  have hnot : ∀ i : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr i ∉ H := by
    intro i hi
    rcases hi with ⟨j, hj⟩
    cases hj
  have hproper : H ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    have hi : DihedralGroup.sr (0 : ZMod n) ∈ H := by
      rw [htop]
      trivial
    exact hnot 0 hi
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [hRH]
  · intro i hi
    exact hnot i (hRH ▸ hi)
  · intro K hK hsr
    rcases hsr with ⟨i, hi⟩
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    cases x with
    | r j =>
        exact hK (hRH ▸ ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    | sr j =>
        have hr : DihedralGroup.r (j - i) ∈ K :=
          hK (hRH ▸ ⟨j - i, rfl⟩)
        simpa using K.mul_mem hi hr

log.message: All goals closed.

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem rotation_subgroup_reflections {n : ℕ} {hn : n ≠ 0}
    {R : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n)}
    (hR : R = Subgroup.closure {DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)}) :
    R ≠ ⊤ ∧
      (∀ i : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr i ∉ R) ∧
      (∀ K : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n), R ≤ K →
        (∃ i : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr i ∈ K) → K = ⊤) := by
  have hrot : ∀ j : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.r j ∈ R := by
    intro j
    rw [hR, Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton]
    refine ⟨(j.cast : ℤ), ?_⟩
    rw [DihedralGroup.r_one_zpow]
    exact congrArg DihedralGroup.r (ZMod.intCast_zmod_cast j)
  
  have hproper : R ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    have hs :
        DihedralGroup.sr (0 : ZMod n) ∈
          Subgroup.closure {DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)} := by
      rw [← hR, htop]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top _
    rw [Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton] at hs
    rcases hs with ⟨k, hk⟩
    simp [DihedralGroup.r_one_zpow] at hk
  
  refine ⟨hproper, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hs :
        DihedralGroup.sr i ∈
          Subgroup.closure {DihedralGroup.r (1 : ZMod n)} := by
      rw [← hR]
      exact hi
    rw [Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton] at hs
    rcases hs with ⟨k, hk⟩
    simp [DihedralGroup.r_one_zpow] at hk
  
  · intro K hRK hreflection
    rcases hreflection with ⟨i, hi⟩
    apply (eq_top_iff).2
    intro g hg
    cases g with
    | r j =>
        exact hRK (hrot j)
    | sr j =>
        have hr : DihedralGroup.r (j - i) ∈ K :=
          hRK (hrot (j - i))
        simpa using K.mul_mem hi hr
